```{r}


## ===== RUN THIS RIGHT AFTER fit_shan and fit_obs ARE CREATED =====

# packages
library(broom.mixed)
library(emmeans)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(forcats)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)
library(ggplot2)

# Timepoint order
tp_levels <- c("t0","t0-6","t0-12","t0-18","t0-24","t0-30","t0-36","t0-over42")

# ---------- Pretty labels for fixed terms (CONTROL is the reference) ----------
pretty_label <- function(x, ref_dx = "CONTROL") {
  x %>%
    # MAIN TIMEPOINTS (CONTROL as ref): capture suffix and append "vs t0"
    stringr::str_replace("^onset_timeline_combined(.*)$", "TP (CONTROL): \\1 vs t0") %>%
    # INTERACTIONS (drop the "CELIAC" word)
    stringr::str_replace("^Dx\\.Status.*:onset_timeline_combined", "Dx × TP: ") %>%
    # MAIN Dx
    stringr::str_replace("^Dx\\.StatusCELIAC$", paste0("Dx: CELIAC (vs ", ref_dx, ")")) %>%
    # OTHER COVARIATES (your set)
    stringr::str_replace("^SexMale$", "Sex: Male (vs Female)") %>%
    stringr::str_replace("^HLA\\.CategoryHigh Risk$", "HLA: High Risk (vs Ref)") %>%
    stringr::str_replace("^HLA\\.CategoryLow/No Risk$", "HLA: Low/No Risk (vs Ref)") %>%
    stringr::str_replace("^feeding_first_yearFormula$", "Feeding: Formula (vs Breastmilk)") %>%
    stringr::str_replace("^feeding_first_yearBreastmilk_and_formula$", "Feeding: Mixed (vs Breastmilk)") %>%
    stringr::str_replace("^Delivery\\.ModeC-Section$", "Delivery: C-Section (vs Vaginal)") %>%
    stringr::str_replace("^Age\\.at\\.Gluten\\.Introduction\\.\\.months\\.$", "Age at gluten intro (months)")
}

# ---------- Standardize emmeans output ----------
emm_summary_df <- function(emm_contrast) {
  s <- as_tibble(summary(emm_contrast, infer = c(TRUE, TRUE)))
  if (!all(c("lower.CL","upper.CL") %in% names(s))) {
    ci <- as_tibble(confint(emm_contrast))
    by_keys <- intersect(names(ci), names(s))
    s <- left_join(s, select(ci, any_of(c(by_keys, "lower.CL", "upper.CL"))), by = by_keys)
  }
  if (!all(c("lower.CL","upper.CL") %in% names(s)) && all(c("estimate","SE") %in% names(s))) {
    s <- mutate(s, lower.CL = estimate - 1.96*SE, upper.CL = estimate + 1.96*SE)
  }
  s
}

# ---------- Helpers to build contrast tables ----------
# A) TP vs t0 within a Dx level (we'll use for CONTROL)
tp_vs_t0_tbl <- function(fit, dx_level, tp_levels, type_link = TRUE) {
  emm <- emmeans(
    fit, ~ onset_timeline_combined | Dx.Status,
    at   = list(onset_timeline_combined = tp_levels),
    type = if (type_link) "link" else "response"
  )
  out <- contrast(emm, method = "trt.vs.ctrl", ref = which(tp_levels == "t0"))
  s   <- emm_summary_df(out)

  s %>%
    filter(Dx.Status == dx_level) %>%
    mutate(
      lhs = str_trim(str_remove(contrast, " - t0$")),
      rhs = "t0",
      term_label = paste0("TP (", dx_level, "): ", lhs, " vs ", rhs),
      section = "TP vs t0 (within group)",
      lhs_key = factor(lhs, levels = tp_levels),
      rhs_key = factor(rhs, levels = tp_levels)
    )
}

# B) Adjacent timepoint contrasts within a Dx level (enforce exact adjacency)
tp_adjacent_tbl <- function(fit, dx_level, tp_levels, type_link = TRUE) {
  emm <- emmeans(
    fit, ~ onset_timeline_combined | Dx.Status,
    at   = list(onset_timeline_combined = tp_levels),
    type = if (type_link) "link" else "response"
  )

  out <- contrast(emm, method = "consec")              # consecutive diffs in tp_levels order
  s   <- emm_summary_df(out)                           # ensures we have lower.CL/upper.CL

  s %>%
    dplyr::filter(Dx.Status == dx_level) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      # emmeans names are like "t0-12 - t0-6" → convert to "t0-12 vs t0-6"
      term_label = paste0("Adjacent (", dx_level, "): ",
                          stringr::str_replace(contrast, "\\s-\\s", " vs ")),
      section    = "Adjacent TP (within group)",
      # extract lhs/rhs for ordering keys
      lhs = stringr::str_extract(contrast, "^[^\\-]+") |> stringr::str_trim(),
      rhs = stringr::str_extract(contrast, "(?<=-)\\s*.*$") |> stringr::str_trim(),
      lhs_key = factor(lhs, levels = tp_levels),
      rhs_key = factor(rhs, levels = tp_levels),
      # simple within-group running index (1 = t0-6 vs t0, 2 = t0-12 vs t0-6, …)
      adj_index = dplyr::row_number()
    ) %>%
    dplyr::rename(conf.low = lower.CL, conf.high = upper.CL)
}


# C) Between-group (CONTROL vs CELIAC) at each timepoint
dx_by_tp_tbl <- function(fit, tp_levels, type_link = TRUE) {
  emm <- emmeans(
    fit, ~ Dx.Status | onset_timeline_combined,
    at   = list(onset_timeline_combined = tp_levels),
    type = if (type_link) "link" else "response"
  )
  out <- contrast(emm, method = "revpairwise")
  s   <- emm_summary_df(out)

  s %>%
    filter(str_detect(contrast, "CELIAC\\s*-\\s*CONTROL")) %>%
    mutate(
      term_label = paste0("CONTROL vs CELIAC @ ", onset_timeline_combined),
      section    = "Between groups at each TP",
      lhs_key    = factor(onset_timeline_combined, levels = tp_levels),
      rhs_key    = lhs_key
    )
}

# D) Fixed terms (tidy)
fixed_terms_tbl <- function(fit, model_label) {
  tidy(fit, effects = "fixed", conf.int = TRUE) %>%
    filter(term != "(Intercept)") %>%
    mutate(
      term_label = pretty_label(term, ref_dx = "CELIAC"),
      section    = "Fixed terms",
      model      = model_label
    ) %>%
    select(model, section, term_label, estimate, conf.low, conf.high, p.value)
}

# ---------- Master builder for ONE fit ----------
build_all_sections <- function(fit, model_label,
                               tp_levels,
                               dx_levels_vst0 = "CONTROL",                 # CONTROL vs t0
                               dx_levels_adj  = c("CELIAC","CONTROL"),     # adjacent for both
                               type_link = TRUE, p_adjust = "BH") {

  # --- fixed terms (already have conf.low/conf.high) ---
  fixed_tbl <- fixed_terms_tbl(fit, model_label) %>%
    mutate(source = "fixed")

  # --- emmeans tables ---
  vs_t0_tbl <- purrr::map_dfr(dx_levels_vst0, ~ tp_vs_t0_tbl(fit, .x, tp_levels, type_link))
  adj_tbl   <- purrr::map_dfr(dx_levels_adj,  ~ tp_adjacent_tbl(fit, .x, tp_levels, type_link))
  dx_tp_tbl <- dx_by_tp_tbl(fit, tp_levels, type_link)

  # Standardize column names for all emmeans outputs
  std_emm <- function(df) {
    df %>%
      # emmeans gives lower.CL / upper.CL; rename to the plotting names
      dplyr::rename(conf.low  = dplyr::any_of("lower.CL"),
                    conf.high = dplyr::any_of("upper.CL")) %>%
      # keep required columns (others are kept if present)
      dplyr::select(dplyr::any_of(c(
        "section","term_label","estimate","conf.low","conf.high","p.value",
        "lhs_key","rhs_key","adj_index"
      )), dplyr::everything())
  }

  emm_tbl <- dplyr::bind_rows(
    std_emm(vs_t0_tbl),
    std_emm(adj_tbl),
    std_emm(dx_tp_tbl)
  ) %>%
    mutate(source = "emmeans")

  # --- combine & compute FDR inside each model×section ---
  res <- dplyr::bind_rows(fixed_tbl, emm_tbl) %>%
    mutate(model = model_label) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(model, section) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(p.adj = p.adjust(p.value, method = p_adjust),
                  sig   = p.adj < 0.05) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup()

  # ensure helpers exist for ordering (used later)
  if (!"adj_index" %in% names(res)) res$adj_index <- NA_integer_
  if (!"lhs_key"   %in% names(res)) res$lhs_key   <- factor(NA, levels = tp_levels)
  if (!"rhs_key"   %in% names(res)) res$rhs_key   <- factor(NA, levels = tp_levels)

  res
}


# ---------- Build data for BOTH models ----------
dat_all <- bind_rows(
  build_all_sections(fit_shan, model_label = "Shannon",               tp_levels = tp_levels),
  build_all_sections(fit_obs,  model_label = "Observed (link scale)", tp_levels = tp_levels)
)

# Ensure ordering helpers exist
if (!"adj_index" %in% names(dat_all)) dat_all$adj_index <- NA_integer_

# Final label normalizations (safety)
dat_all <- dat_all %>%
  mutate(
    term_label = str_replace(term_label, "^Between groups:\\s*", ""),                    # just in case
    term_label = str_replace(term_label, "^TP \\(CONTROL\\): \\((t0(?:-(?:\\d+|over\\d+))?)\\) vs t0$", "TP (CONTROL): \\1 vs t0"),
    term_label = str_replace(term_label, "\\s+vs\\s+t0(?:\\s+vs\\s+t0)+$", " vs t0"),   # dedupe "vs t0"
    term_label = str_replace(term_label, "^Dx: CONTROL ×", "Dx ×")
  )


# Helper to extract a TP token from any label
extract_tp <- function(x) str_extract(x, "t0(?:-(?:\\d+|over\\d+))?|t0")

# ---------- Re-block and order ----------
dat_all <- dat_all %>%
  mutate(
    tp_token = extract_tp(term_label),
    tp_key   = factor(tp_token, levels = tp_levels),

    block = case_when(
      section == "Between groups at each TP"                                              ~ "Between groups at each TP",
      section == "TP vs t0 (within group)" & str_detect(term_label, "^TP \\(CONTROL\\):") ~ "TP vs t0 (CONTROL)",
      section == "Fixed terms"            & str_detect(term_label, "^TP \\(CELIAC\\):")   ~ "TP vs t0 (CELIAC)",
      section == "Adjacent TP (within group)" & str_detect(term_label, "\\(CONTROL\\)")  ~ "Adjacent TP (CONTROL)",
      section == "Adjacent TP (within group)" & str_detect(term_label, "\\(CELIAC\\)")   ~ "Adjacent TP (CELIAC)",
      section == "Fixed terms"            & str_detect(term_label, "^Dx × TP: ")         ~ "Dx × TP interactions",
      section == "Fixed terms"            & str_detect(term_label, "^Dx: CONTROL \\(vs CELIAC\\)") ~ "Dx main effect",
      section == "Fixed terms"                                                          ~ "Other covariates",
      TRUE                                                                              ~ "Other covariates"
    ),
    block = factor(block, levels = c(
      "Between groups at each TP",
      "TP vs t0 (CONTROL)",
      "TP vs t0 (CELIAC)",
      "Adjacent TP (CONTROL)",
      "Adjacent TP (CELIAC)",
      "Dx × TP interactions",
      "Dx main effect",
      "Other covariates"
    ))
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    model, block,
    if_else(is.na(adj_index), Inf, as.double(adj_index)),  # strict order for Adjacent panels
    as.numeric(tp_key),                                    # order by timepoint elsewhere
    term_label
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    term_label = dplyr::if_else(
      section == "Adjacent TP (within group)",
      stringr::str_replace_all(term_label, "\\((t0(?:-(?:\\d+|over\\d+))?)\\)", "\\1"),
      term_label
    )
  )  %>%
  dplyr::group_by(model, block) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(term_label = forcats::fct_relevel(term_label, unique(term_label))) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()



# ---------- Plot ----------
US_orf_alpha_p <- ggplot(dat_all, aes(y = forcats::fct_rev(term_label), x = estimate)) +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = conf.low, xmax = conf.high), height = 0.2) +
  geom_point(aes(color = sig), size = 2.5) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = "red", `FALSE` = "black")) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +   # one reference line for all panels
  facet_grid(block ~ model, scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") +
  labs(
    title = "Timepoint effects, between-group contrasts, interactions, and covariates",
    subtitle = "Observed shown on log(IRR) (ref=0). Shannon shown as raw differences (ref=0).",
    x = "Effect size (log(IRR) for Observed; difference for Shannon)",
    y = NULL,
    caption = "Red: BH FDR < 0.05; 95% CIs"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
theme(
  legend.position = "none",
  strip.text.y = element_blank(),        # hide right-side facet labels
  strip.background.y = element_blank(),  # remove the right-side strip background
  strip.text.x = element_text(face = "bold")  # keep top labels bold
)

US_orf_alpha_p

ggsave(US_orf_alpha_p,file="~/Handley Lab Dropbox/16S/Celiac/Phage/phage_detection_pipeline_new_assembly/Virome/Orf_Contig_Phrog_compositional/orf_contig_results_figures/orf/US_orf_alpha_p.pdf",dpi = 600,width = 10, height = 10)
```

```{r}
}

# ---------- Standardize emmeans output ----------
emm_summary_df <- function(emm_contrast) {
  s <- as_tibble(summary(emm_contrast, infer = c(TRUE, TRUE)))
  if (!all(c("lower.CL","upper.CL") %in% names(s))) {
    ci <- as_tibble(confint(emm_contrast))
    by_keys <- intersect(names(ci), names(s))
    s <- left_join(s, select(ci, any_of(c(by_keys, "lower.CL", "upper.CL"))), by = by_keys)
  }
  if (!all(c("lower.CL","upper.CL") %in% names(s)) && all(c("estimate","SE") %in% names(s))) {

  }
  s
}

# ---------- Helpers to build contrast tables ----------
# A) TP vs t0 within a Dx level (we'll use for CONTROL)
tp_vs_t0_tbl <- function(fit, dx_level, tp_levels, type_link = TRUE) {
  emm <- emmeans(
    fit, ~ onset_timeline_combined | Dx.Status,
    at   = list(onset_timeline_combined = tp_levels),
    type = if (type_link) "link" else "response"
  )
  out <- contrast(emm, method = "trt.vs.ctrl", ref = which(tp_levels == "t0"))
  s   <- emm_summary_df(out)

  s %>%
    filter(Dx.Status == dx_level) %>%
    mutate(
      lhs = str_trim(str_remove(contrast, " - t0$")),
      rhs = "t0",
      term_label = paste0("TP (", dx_level, "): ", lhs, " vs ", rhs),
      section = "TP vs t0 (within group)",
      lhs_key = factor(lhs, levels = tp_levels),
      rhs_key = factor(rhs, levels = tp_levels)
    )
}

# B) Adjacent timepoint contrasts within a Dx level (enforce exact adjacency)
tp_adjacent_tbl <- function(fit, dx_level, tp_levels, type_link = TRUE) {
  emm <- emmeans(
    fit, ~ onset_timeline_combined | Dx.Status,
    at   = list(onset_timeline_combined = tp_levels),
    type = if (type_link) "link" else "response"
  )

  out <- contrast(emm, method = "consec")              # consecutive diffs in tp_levels order
  s   <- emm_summary_df(out)                           # ensures we have lower.CL/upper.CL

  s %>%
    dplyr::filter(Dx.Status == dx_level) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      # emmeans names are like "t0-12 - t0-6" → convert to "t0-12 vs t0-6"
      term_label = paste0("Adjacent (", dx_level, "): ",
                          stringr::str_replace(contrast, "\\s-\\s", " vs ")),
      section    = "Adjacent TP (within group)",
      # extract lhs/rhs for ordering keys
      lhs = stringr::str_extract(contrast, "^[^\\-]+") |> stringr::str_trim(),
      rhs = stringr::str_extract(contrast, "(?<=-)\\s*.*$") |> stringr::str_trim(),
      lhs_key = factor(lhs, levels = tp_levels),
      rhs_key = factor(rhs, levels = tp_levels),
      # simple within-group running index (1 = t0-6 vs t0, 2 = t0-12 vs t0-6, …)
      adj_index = dplyr::row_number()
    ) %>%
    dplyr::rename(conf.low = lower.CL, conf.high = upper.CL)
}


# C) Between-group (CONTROL vs CELIAC) at each timepoint
dx_by_tp_tbl <- function(fit, tp_levels, type_link = TRUE) {
  emm <- emmeans(
    fit, ~ Dx.Status | onset_timeline_combined,
    at   = list(onset_timeline_combined = tp_levels),
    type = if (type_link) "link" else "response"
  )
  out <- contrast(emm, method = "revpairwise")
  s   <- emm_summary_df(out)

  s %>%
    filter(str_detect(contrast, "CELIAC\\s*-\\s*CONTROL")) %>%
    mutate(
      term_label = paste0("CONTROL vs CELIAC @ ", onset_timeline_combined),
      section    = "Between groups at each TP",
      lhs_key    = factor(onset_timeline_combined, levels = tp_levels),
      rhs_key    = lhs_key
    )
}

# D) Fixed terms (tidy)
fixed_terms_tbl <- function(fit, model_label) {
  tidy(fit, effects = "fixed", conf.int = TRUE) %>%
    filter(term != "(Intercept)") %>%
    mutate(
      term_label = pretty_label(term, ref_dx = "CELIAC"),
      section    = "Fixed terms",
      model      = model_label
    ) %>%
    select(model, section, term_label, estimate, conf.low, conf.high, p.value)
}

# ---------- Master builder for ONE fit ----------
build_all_sections <- function(fit, model_label,
                               tp_levels,
                               dx_levels_vst0 = "CONTROL",                 # CONTROL vs t0
                               dx_levels_adj  = c("CELIAC","CONTROL"),     # adjacent for both
                               type_link = TRUE, p_adjust = "BH") {

  # --- fixed terms (already have conf.low/conf.high) ---
  fixed_tbl <- fixed_terms_tbl(fit, model_label) %>%
    mutate(source = "fixed")

  # --- emmeans tables ---
  vs_t0_tbl <- purrr::map_dfr(dx_levels_vst0, ~ tp_vs_t0_tbl(fit, .x, tp_levels, type_link))
  adj_tbl   <- purrr::map_dfr(dx_levels_adj,  ~ tp_adjacent_tbl(fit, .x, tp_levels, type_link))
  dx_tp_tbl <- dx_by_tp_tbl(fit, tp_levels, type_link)

  # Standardize column names for all emmeans outputs
  std_emm <- function(df) {
    df %>%
      # emmeans gives lower.CL / upper.CL; rename to the plotting names
      dplyr::rename(conf.low  = dplyr::any_of("lower.CL"),
                    conf.high = dplyr::any_of("upper.CL")) %>%
      # keep required columns (others are kept if present)
      dplyr::select(dplyr::any_of(c(
        "section","term_label","estimate","conf.low","conf.high","p.value",
        "lhs_key","rhs_key","adj_index"
      )), dplyr::everything())
  }

  emm_tbl <- dplyr::bind_rows(
    std_emm(vs_t0_tbl),
    std_emm(adj_tbl),
    std_emm(dx_tp_tbl)
  ) %>%
    mutate(source = "emmeans")

  # --- combine & compute FDR inside each model×section ---
  res <- dplyr::bind_rows(fixed_tbl, emm_tbl) %>%
    mutate(model = model_label) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(model, section) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(p.adj = p.adjust(p.value, method = p_adjust),
                  sig   = p.adj < 0.05) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup()

  # ensure helpers exist for ordering (used later)
  if (!"adj_index" %in% names(res)) res$adj_index <- NA_integer_
  if (!"lhs_key"   %in% names(res)) res$lhs_key   <- factor(NA, levels = tp_levels)
  if (!"rhs_key"   %in% names(res)) res$rhs_key   <- factor(NA, levels = tp_levels)

  res
}


# ---------- Build data for BOTH models ----------
dat_all <- bind_rows(
  build_all_sections(fit_shan, model_label = "Shannon",               tp_levels = tp_levels),
  build_all_sections(fit_obs,  model_label = "Observed (link scale)", tp_levels = tp_levels)
)

# Ensure ordering helpers exist
if (!"adj_index" %in% names(dat_all)) dat_all$adj_index <- NA_integer_

# Final label normalizations (safety)
dat_all <- dat_all %>%
  mutate(
    term_label = str_replace(term_label, "^Between groups:\\s*", ""),                    # just in case
    term_label = str_replace(term_label, "^TP \\(CONTROL\\): \\((t0(?:-(?:\\d+|over\\d+))?)\\) vs t0$", "TP (CONTROL): \\1 vs t0"),
    term_label = str_replace(term_label, "\\s+vs\\s+t0(?:\\s+vs\\s+t0)+$", " vs t0"),   # dedupe "vs t0"
    term_label = str_replace(term_label, "^Dx: CONTROL ×", "Dx ×")
  )


# Helper to extract a TP token from any label
extract_tp <- function(x) str_extract(x, "t0(?:-(?:\\d+|over\\d+))?|t0")

# ---------- Re-block and order ----------
dat_all <- dat_all %>%
  mutate(
    tp_token = extract_tp(term_label),
    tp_key   = factor(tp_token, levels = tp_levels),

    block = case_when(
      section == "Between groups at each TP"                                              ~ "Between groups at each TP",
      section == "TP vs t0 (within group)" & str_detect(term_label, "^TP \\(CONTROL\\):") ~ "TP vs t0 (CONTROL)",
      section == "Fixed terms"            & str_detect(term_label, "^TP \\(CELIAC\\):")   ~ "TP vs t0 (CELIAC)",
      section == "Adjacent TP (within group)" & str_detect(term_label, "\\(CONTROL\\)")  ~ "Adjacent TP (CONTROL)",
      section == "Adjacent TP (within group)" & str_detect(term_label, "\\(CELIAC\\)")   ~ "Adjacent TP (CELIAC)",
      section == "Fixed terms"            & str_detect(term_label, "^Dx × TP: ")         ~ "Dx × TP interactions",
      section == "Fixed terms"            & str_detect(term_label, "^Dx: CONTROL \\(vs CELIAC\\)") ~ "Dx main effect",
      section == "Fixed terms"                                                          ~ "Other covariates",
      TRUE                                                                              ~ "Other covariates"
    ),
    block = factor(block, levels = c(
      "Between groups at each TP",
      "TP vs t0 (CONTROL)",
      "TP vs t0 (CELIAC)",
      "Adjacent TP (CONTROL)",
      "Adjacent TP (CELIAC)",
      "Dx × TP interactions",
      "Dx main effect",
      "Other covariates"
    ))
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    model, block,
    if_else(is.na(adj_index), Inf, as.double(adj_index)),  # strict order for Adjacent panels
    as.numeric(tp_key),                                    # order by timepoint elsewhere
    term_label
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    term_label = dplyr::if_else(
      section == "Adjacent TP (within group)",
      stringr::str_replace_all(term_label, "\\((t0(?:-(?:\\d+|over\\d+))?)\\)", "\\1"),
      term_label
    )
  )  %>%
  dplyr::group_by(model, block) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(term_label = forcats::fct_relevel(term_label, unique(term_label))) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()



# ---------- Plot ----------
Italy_orf_alpha_p <- ggplot(dat_all, aes(y = forcats::fct_rev(term_label), x = estimate)) +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = conf.low, xmax = conf.high), height = 0.2) +
  geom_point(aes(color = sig), size = 2.5) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = "red", `FALSE` = "black")) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +   # one reference line for all panels
  facet_grid(block ~ model, scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") +
  labs(
    title = "Timepoint effects, between-group contrasts, interactions, and covariates",
    subtitle = "Observed shown on log(IRR) (ref=0). Shannon shown as raw differences (ref=0).",
    x = "Effect size (log(IRR) for Observed; difference for Shannon)",
    y = NULL,
    caption = "Red: BH FDR < 0.05; 95% CIs"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
theme(
  legend.position = "none",
  strip.text.y = element_blank(),        # hide right-side facet labels
  strip.background.y = element_blank(),  # remove the right-side strip background
  strip.text.x = element_text(face = "bold")  # keep top labels bold
)
```

# Compositional analysis selfmade - Beta


# total - fit the model
```{r}

# Packages
library(tidyverse)
library(vegan)
library(MDMR)

set.seed(123)
# ---- Inputs ----
counts <- total.orf.abundance.clean_0.75 %>% as.data.frame() %>% as.matrix()
meta   <- total.orf.metadata.clean_0.75 %>% as.data.frame() %>% tibble::rownames_to_column("sample_id")

# Align samples
common <- intersect(colnames(counts), meta$sample_id)
counts <- counts[, common, drop = FALSE]
meta   <- meta  %>% filter(sample_id %in% common)

# Bray–Curtis on relative abundances
X        <- t(counts)  # samples x ORFs
row_sums <- rowSums(X)
X_rel    <- sweep(X, 1, pmax(row_sums, 1e-12), "/")
D_bray   <- vegdist(X_rel, method = "bray")

# Reorder metadata to match distance matrix
ord_ids <- rownames(as.matrix(D_bray))
meta    <- meta %>% slice(match(ord_ids, sample_id))

# Coerce factors (important)
meta <- meta %>%
  mutate(
    Dx.Status = forcats::fct_relevel(as.factor(Dx.Status), "CONTROL"),
    Country = forcats::fct_relevel(as.factor(Country), "ITALY"),
    onset_timeline_combined = as.factor(onset_timeline_combined),
    patientID = as.factor(patientID),
    Sex = as.factor(Sex),
    HLA.Category = as.factor(HLA.Category),
    feeding_first_year = as.factor(feeding_first_year),
    Delivery.Mode = as.factor(Delivery.Mode),
    Age.at.Gluten.Introduction..months. = as.numeric(Age.at.Gluten.Introduction..months.)
  )

# ---- mixed MDMR: fixed effects + random intercept for patientID ----
fmla_mixed <- ~ Dx.Status * onset_timeline_combined + Country + Sex + Age.at.Gluten.Introduction..months. +
               HLA.Category + feeding_first_year + Delivery.Mode + (1 | patientID)

# Tip for Bray (non-Euclidean): use.ssd ~ 0.99 can speed up
fit_mmdmr <- mixed.mdmr(
  fmla = fmla_mixed,
  data = meta,
  D    = D_bray,
  use.ssd = 0.99,   # set to 1.00 if you prefer full SSD (slower)
  ncores = 1        # >1 uses forking; keep 1 on Windows
)
```

# total - extract outputs and make plots
```{r}

# ===== Run this AFTER you built D_bray and meta =====
library(permute)   # for restricted permutations within patient
library(vegan)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)
library(forcats)
library(ggplot2)
library(permute)

set.seed(123)

# Small helper to build a formula like D_sub ~ <rhs>
fmla_from_rhs <- function(rhs) as.formula(paste("D_sub ~", rhs))



# Build formula like: D_sub ~ <rhs>
fmla_from_rhs <- function(rhs) as.formula(paste("D_sub ~", rhs))

adonis_on_subset <- function(D, ds, rhs, term, nperm = 999) {
  # Guard 1: need at least 2 samples
  if (nrow(ds) < 2) {
    return(tibble(term = term, R2 = NA_real_, F = NA_real_, p.value = NA_real_))
  }

  ids <- ds$sample_id
  # Guard 2: distance submatrix must be at least 2x2
  if (length(ids) < 2) {
    return(tibble(term = term, R2 = NA_real_, F = NA_real_, p.value = NA_real_))
  }
  D_sub <- as.dist(as.matrix(D)[ids, ids])

  # Guard 3: tested term must have ≥2 levels
  if (!(term %in% names(ds)) || n_distinct(ds[[term]]) < 2) {
    return(tibble(term = term, R2 = NA_real_, F = NA_real_, p.value = NA_real_))
  }

  # Choose permutation scheme safely
  has_blocks <- "patientID" %in% names(ds) && n_distinct(ds$patientID) >= 2
  any_block_has_rep <- has_blocks && any(table(ds$patientID) >= 2)
  perm_scheme <- if (has_blocks && any_block_has_rep) {
    # restrict within patient when it makes sense
    how(blocks = droplevels(ds$patientID))
  } else {
    # fall back to free permutations
    nperm
  }

  fit <- adonis2(
    fmla_from_rhs(rhs),
    data         = ds,
    permutations = perm_scheme,
    by           = "margin"
  )

  tb <- as.data.frame(fit)
  if (!(term %in% rownames(tb))) {
    return(tibble(term = term, R2 = NA_real_, F = NA_real_, p.value = NA_real_))
  }
  tibble(
    term    = term,
    R2      = tb[term, "R2", drop = TRUE],
    F       = tb[term, "F",  drop = TRUE],
    p.value = tb[term, "Pr(>F)", drop = TRUE]
  )
}


# 1) Between groups at each TP
between_tp <- map_dfr(tp_levels, function(tp) {
  ds <- meta %>% filter(onset_timeline_combined == tp)
  if (n_distinct(ds$Dx.Status) < 2) return(NULL)
  adonis_on_subset(
    D_bray, ds,
    rhs  = "Dx.Status + Country + Sex + Age.at.Gluten.Introduction..months. +
            HLA.Category + feeding_first_year + Delivery.Mode",
    term = "Dx.Status"
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      section    = "Between groups at each TP",
      term_label = paste0("CONTROL vs CELIAC @ ", tp),
      lhs_key    = factor(tp, levels = tp_levels),
      rhs_key    = lhs_key
    )
})

# 2) TP vs t0 within group (CONTROL and CELIAC)
tp_vs_t0 <- map_dfr(c("CONTROL","CELIAC"), function(dx) {
  map_dfr(tp_levels[-1], function(tp) {
    ds <- meta %>% filter(Dx.Status == dx,
                          onset_timeline_combined %in% c("t0", tp))
    if (n_distinct(ds$onset_timeline_combined) < 2) return(NULL)
    adonis_on_subset(
      D_bray, ds,
      rhs  = "onset_timeline_combined + Country + Sex + Age.at.Gluten.Introduction..months. +
              HLA.Category + feeding_first_year + Delivery.Mode",
      term = "onset_timeline_combined"
    ) %>%
      mutate(
        section    = "TP vs t0 (within group)",
        term_label = paste0("TP (", dx, "): ", tp, " vs t0"),
        lhs_key    = factor(tp, levels = tp_levels),
        rhs_key    = factor("t0", levels = tp_levels)
      )
  })
})

# 3) Adjacent TP within group (CONTROL and CELIAC)
adjacent_pairs <- tibble(lhs = tp_levels[-1], rhs = tp_levels[-length(tp_levels)])
tp_adjacent <- map_dfr(c("CONTROL","CELIAC"), function(dx) {
  pmap_dfr(adjacent_pairs, function(lhs, rhs) {
    ds <- meta %>% filter(Dx.Status == dx,
                          onset_timeline_combined %in% c(lhs, rhs))
    if (n_distinct(ds$onset_timeline_combined) < 2) return(NULL)
    adonis_on_subset(
      D_bray, ds,
      rhs  = "onset_timeline_combined + Country + Sex + Age.at.Gluten.Introduction..months. +
              HLA.Category + feeding_first_year + Delivery.Mode",
      term = "onset_timeline_combined"
    ) %>%
      mutate(
        section    = "Adjacent TP (within group)",
        term_label = paste0("Adjacent (", dx, "): ", lhs, " vs ", rhs),
        lhs_key    = factor(lhs, levels = tp_levels),
        rhs_key    = factor(rhs, levels = tp_levels),
        adj_index  = match(lhs, tp_levels)  # 2..n to enforce order
      )
  })
})

# 4) Global model (Dx × TP and covariates)
{
  ds    <- meta
  ids   <- ds$sample_id
  D_sub <- as.dist(as.matrix(D_bray)[ids, ids])
  fit_global <- adonis2(
    D_sub ~ Dx.Status * onset_timeline_combined + Country + Sex +
             Age.at.Gluten.Introduction..months. +
             HLA.Category + feeding_first_year + Delivery.Mode,
    data         = ds,
    permutations = how(blocks = ds$patientID),
    by           = "margin"
  )
  global_terms <- as.data.frame(fit_global) %>%
    rownames_to_column("term") %>%
    transmute(
      term,
      R2, F,
      p.value = `Pr(>F)`,
      section = "Fixed terms",
      term_label = case_when(
        term == "Dx.Status:onset_timeline_combined" ~ "Dx × TP (global)",
        term == "Dx.Status"                         ~ "Dx: CONTROL (vs CELIAC) (global)",
        term == "onset_timeline_combined"           ~ "TP (global)",
        term == "Country"                           ~ "Country (global)",
        term == "Sex"                               ~ "Sex (global)",
        term == "Age.at.Gluten.Introduction..months." ~ "Age at gluten intro (months) (global)",
        term == "HLA.Category"                      ~ "HLA category (global)",
        term == "feeding_first_year"                ~ "Feeding (global)",
        term == "Delivery.Mode"                     ~ "Delivery mode (global)",
        TRUE ~ term
      )
    )
}

# Combine all, set blocks & ordering to mirror alpha plot style
dat_beta <- bind_rows(between_tp, tp_vs_t0, tp_adjacent, global_terms) %>%
  mutate(
    estimate = R2,
    conf.low = NA_real_,            # no CIs from permutation MANOVA
    conf.high= NA_real_,
    p.adj = p.adjust(p.value, method = "BH"),
    sig   = !is.na(p.adj) & p.adj < 0.05,
    model = "Bray–Curtis (R² effect size)"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    block = case_when(
      section == "Between groups at each TP"                                               ~ "Between groups at each TP",
      section == "TP vs t0 (within group)" & str_detect(term_label, "^TP \\(CONTROL\\):")  ~ "TP vs t0 (CONTROL)",
      section == "TP vs t0 (within group)" & str_detect(term_label, "^TP \\(CELIAC\\):")   ~ "TP vs t0 (CELIAC)",
      section == "Adjacent TP (within group)" & str_detect(term_label, "\\(CONTROL\\)")    ~ "Adjacent TP (CONTROL)",
      section == "Adjacent TP (within group)" & str_detect(term_label, "\\(CELIAC\\)")     ~ "Adjacent TP (CELIAC)",
      section == "Fixed terms" & term_label == "Dx × TP (global)"                           ~ "Dx × TP interactions",
      section == "Fixed terms" & str_detect(term_label, "^Dx: CONTROL \\(vs CELIAC\\)")     ~ "Dx main effect",
      section == "Fixed terms"                                                              ~ "Other covariates",
      TRUE                                                                                  ~ "Other covariates"
    ),
    block = factor(block, levels = c(
      "Between groups at each TP",
      "TP vs t0 (CONTROL)",
      "TP vs t0 (CELIAC)",
      "Adjacent TP (CONTROL)",
      "Adjacent TP (CELIAC)",
      "Dx × TP interactions",
      "Dx main effect",
      "Other covariates"
    )),
    # order within blocks
    tp_token = str_extract(term_label, "t0(?:-(?:\\d+|over\\d+))?|t0"),
    tp_key   = factor(tp_token, levels = tp_levels)
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    block,
    if_else(!is.na(adj_index), as.double(adj_index), Inf),  # enforce adjacent order
    as.numeric(tp_key),
    term_label
  ) %>%
  group_by(block) %>%
  mutate(term_label = forcats::fct_relevel(term_label, unique(term_label))) %>%
  ungroup()

# Plot (partial R²; reference line at 0)
p_beta <- ggplot(dat_beta, aes(y = fct_rev(term_label), x = estimate)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = sig), size = 2.5, na.rm = TRUE) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = "red", `FALSE` = "black")) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  facet_grid(block ~ model, scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") +
  labs(
    title = "Bray–Curtis β-diversity: timepoint contrasts, group differences, interactions, covariates",
    subtitle = "Effect size = partial R² from permutation MANOVA (adonis2 with permutations restricted within patientID).",
    x = "Effect size (partial R²)",
    y = NULL,
    caption = "Red: BH FDR < 0.05; CIs not shown for permutation MANOVA."
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    strip.text.y = element_blank(),        # hide right-side facet labels
    strip.background.y = element_blank(),
    strip.text.x = element_text(face = "bold")
  )
```

```{r}
    onset_timeline_combined = as.factor(onset_timeline_combined),
    patientID = as.factor(patientID),
    Sex = as.factor(Sex),
    HLA.Category = as.factor(HLA.Category),
    feeding_first_year = as.factor(feeding_first_year),
    Delivery.Mode = as.factor(Delivery.Mode),
    Age.at.Gluten.Introduction..months. = as.numeric(Age.at.Gluten.Introduction..months.)
  )

# ---- mixed MDMR: fixed effects + random intercept for patientID ----
fmla_mixed <- ~ Dx.Status * onset_timeline_combined + Sex + Age.at.Gluten.Introduction..months. +
               HLA.Category + feeding_first_year + Delivery.Mode + (1 | patientID)

# Tip for Bray (non-Euclidean): use.ssd ~ 0.99 can speed up
fit_mmdmr <- mixed.mdmr(
  fmla = fmla_mixed,
  data = meta,
```

```{r}

# ===== Run this AFTER you built D_bray and meta =====
library(permute)   # for restricted permutations within patient
library(vegan)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)
library(forcats)
library(ggplot2)

set.seed(123)

# Small helper to build a formula like D_sub ~ <rhs>
fmla_from_rhs <- function(rhs) as.formula(paste("D_sub ~", rhs))

library(permute)

# Build formula like: D_sub ~ <rhs>
fmla_from_rhs <- function(rhs) as.formula(paste("D_sub ~", rhs))

adonis_on_subset <- function(D, ds, rhs, term, nperm = 999) {
  # Guard 1: need at least 2 samples
  if (nrow(ds) < 2) {
    return(tibble(term = term, R2 = NA_real_, F = NA_real_, p.value = NA_real_))
  }

  ids <- ds$sample_id
  # Guard 2: distance submatrix must be at least 2x2
  if (length(ids) < 2) {
    return(tibble(term = term, R2 = NA_real_, F = NA_real_, p.value = NA_real_))
  }
  D_sub <- as.dist(as.matrix(D)[ids, ids])

  # Guard 3: tested term must have ≥2 levels
  if (!(term %in% names(ds)) || n_distinct(ds[[term]]) < 2) {
    return(tibble(term = term, R2 = NA_real_, F = NA_real_, p.value = NA_real_))
  }

  # Choose permutation scheme safely
  has_blocks <- "patientID" %in% names(ds) && n_distinct(ds$patientID) >= 2
  any_block_has_rep <- has_blocks && any(table(ds$patientID) >= 2)
  perm_scheme <- if (has_blocks && any_block_has_rep) {
    # restrict within patient when it makes sense
    how(blocks = droplevels(ds$patientID))
  } else {
    # fall back to free permutations
    nperm
  }

  fit <- adonis2(
    fmla_from_rhs(rhs),
    data         = ds,
    permutations = perm_scheme,
    by           = "margin"
  )

  tb <- as.data.frame(fit)
  if (!(term %in% rownames(tb))) {
    return(tibble(term = term, R2 = NA_real_, F = NA_real_, p.value = NA_real_))
  }
  tibble(
    term    = term,
    R2      = tb[term, "R2", drop = TRUE],
    F       = tb[term, "F",  drop = TRUE],
    p.value = tb[term, "Pr(>F)", drop = TRUE]
  )
}


# 1) Between groups at each TP
between_tp <- map_dfr(tp_levels, function(tp) {
  ds <- meta %>% filter(onset_timeline_combined == tp)
  if (n_distinct(ds$Dx.Status) < 2) return(NULL)
  adonis_on_subset(
    D_bray, ds,
    rhs  = "Dx.Status + Sex + Age.at.Gluten.Introduction..months. +
            HLA.Category + feeding_first_year + Delivery.Mode",
    term = "Dx.Status"
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      section    = "Between groups at each TP",
      term_label = paste0("CONTROL vs CELIAC @ ", tp),
      lhs_key    = factor(tp, levels = tp_levels),
      rhs_key    = lhs_key
    )
})

# 2) TP vs t0 within group (CONTROL and CELIAC)
tp_vs_t0 <- map_dfr(c("CONTROL","CELIAC"), function(dx) {
  map_dfr(tp_levels[-1], function(tp) {
    ds <- meta %>% filter(Dx.Status == dx,
                          onset_timeline_combined %in% c("t0", tp))
    if (n_distinct(ds$onset_timeline_combined) < 2) return(NULL)
    adonis_on_subset(
      D_bray, ds,
      rhs  = "onset_timeline_combined + Sex + Age.at.Gluten.Introduction..months. +
              HLA.Category + feeding_first_year + Delivery.Mode",
      term = "onset_timeline_combined"
    ) %>%
      mutate(
        section    = "TP vs t0 (within group)",
        term_label = paste0("TP (", dx, "): ", tp, " vs t0"),
        lhs_key    = factor(tp, levels = tp_levels),
        rhs_key    = factor("t0", levels = tp_levels)
      )
  })
})

# 3) Adjacent TP within group (CONTROL and CELIAC)
adjacent_pairs <- tibble(lhs = tp_levels[-1], rhs = tp_levels[-length(tp_levels)])
tp_adjacent <- map_dfr(c("CONTROL","CELIAC"), function(dx) {
  pmap_dfr(adjacent_pairs, function(lhs, rhs) {
    ds <- meta %>% filter(Dx.Status == dx,
                          onset_timeline_combined %in% c(lhs, rhs))
    if (n_distinct(ds$onset_timeline_combined) < 2) return(NULL)
    adonis_on_subset(
      D_bray, ds,
      rhs  = "onset_timeline_combined + Sex + Age.at.Gluten.Introduction..months. +
              HLA.Category + feeding_first_year + Delivery.Mode",
      term = "onset_timeline_combined"
    ) %>%
      mutate(
        section    = "Adjacent TP (within group)",
        term_label = paste0("Adjacent (", dx, "): ", lhs, " vs ", rhs),
        lhs_key    = factor(lhs, levels = tp_levels),
        rhs_key    = factor(rhs, levels = tp_levels),
        adj_index  = match(lhs, tp_levels)  # 2..n to enforce order
      )
  })
})

# 4) Global model (Dx × TP and covariates)
{
  ds    <- meta
  ids   <- ds$sample_id
  D_sub <- as.dist(as.matrix(D_bray)[ids, ids])
  fit_global <- adonis2(
    D_sub ~ Dx.Status * onset_timeline_combined + Sex +
             Age.at.Gluten.Introduction..months. +
             HLA.Category + feeding_first_year + Delivery.Mode,
    data         = ds,
    permutations = how(blocks = ds$patientID),
    by           = "margin"
  )
  global_terms <- as.data.frame(fit_global) %>%
    rownames_to_column("term") %>%
    transmute(
      term,
      R2, F,
      p.value = `Pr(>F)`,
      section = "Fixed terms",
      term_label = case_when(
        term == "Dx.Status:onset_timeline_combined" ~ "Dx × TP (global)",
        term == "Dx.Status"                         ~ "Dx: CONTROL (vs CELIAC) (global)",
        term == "onset_timeline_combined"           ~ "TP (global)",
        term == "Sex"                               ~ "Sex (global)",
        term == "Age.at.Gluten.Introduction..months." ~ "Age at gluten intro (months) (global)",
        term == "HLA.Category"                      ~ "HLA category (global)",
        term == "feeding_first_year"                ~ "Feeding (global)",
        term == "Delivery.Mode"                     ~ "Delivery mode (global)",
        TRUE ~ term
      )
    )
}

# Combine all, set blocks & ordering to mirror alpha plot style
dat_beta <- bind_rows(between_tp, tp_vs_t0, tp_adjacent, global_terms) %>%
  mutate(
    estimate = R2,
    conf.low = NA_real_,            # no CIs from permutation MANOVA
    conf.high= NA_real_,
    p.adj = p.adjust(p.value, method = "BH"),
    sig   = !is.na(p.adj) & p.adj < 0.05,
    model = "Bray–Curtis (R² effect size)"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    block = case_when(
      section == "Between groups at each TP"                                               ~ "Between groups at each TP",
      section == "TP vs t0 (within group)" & str_detect(term_label, "^TP \\(CONTROL\\):")  ~ "TP vs t0 (CONTROL)",
      section == "TP vs t0 (within group)" & str_detect(term_label, "^TP \\(CELIAC\\):")   ~ "TP vs t0 (CELIAC)",
      section == "Adjacent TP (within group)" & str_detect(term_label, "\\(CONTROL\\)")    ~ "Adjacent TP (CONTROL)",
      section == "Adjacent TP (within group)" & str_detect(term_label, "\\(CELIAC\\)")     ~ "Adjacent TP (CELIAC)",
      section == "Fixed terms" & term_label == "Dx × TP (global)"                           ~ "Dx × TP interactions",
      section == "Fixed terms" & str_detect(term_label, "^Dx: CONTROL \\(vs CELIAC\\)")     ~ "Dx main effect",
      section == "Fixed terms"                                                              ~ "Other covariates",
      TRUE                                                                                  ~ "Other covariates"
    ),
    block = factor(block, levels = c(
      "Between groups at each TP",
      "TP vs t0 (CONTROL)",
      "TP vs t0 (CELIAC)",
      "Adjacent TP (CONTROL)",
      "Adjacent TP (CELIAC)",
      "Dx × TP interactions",
      "Dx main effect",
      "Other covariates"
    )),
    # order within blocks
    tp_token = str_extract(term_label, "t0(?:-(?:\\d+|over\\d+))?|t0"),
    tp_key   = factor(tp_token, levels = tp_levels)
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    block,
    if_else(!is.na(adj_index), as.double(adj_index), Inf),  # enforce adjacent order
    as.numeric(tp_key),
    term_label
  ) %>%
  group_by(block) %>%
  mutate(term_label = forcats::fct_relevel(term_label, unique(term_label))) %>%
  ungroup()

# Plot (partial R²; reference line at 0)
US_p_beta <- ggplot(dat_beta, aes(y = fct_rev(term_label), x = estimate)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = sig), size = 2.5, na.rm = TRUE) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = "red", `FALSE` = "black")) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  facet_grid(block ~ model, scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") +
  labs(
    title = "Bray–Curtis β-diversity: timepoint contrasts, group differences, interactions, covariates",
    subtitle = "Effect size = partial R² from permutation MANOVA (adonis2 with permutations restricted within patientID).",
    x = "Effect size (partial R²)",
    y = NULL,
    caption = "Red: BH FDR < 0.05; CIs not shown for permutation MANOVA."
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    strip.text.y = element_blank(),        # hide right-side facet labels
    strip.background.y = element_blank(),
    strip.text.x = element_text(face = "bold")
  )

US_p_beta
```

# Italy - fit the model
```{r}

# Packages
library(tidyverse)
library(vegan)
library(MDMR)

set.seed(123)
# ---- Inputs ----
counts <- Italy.orf.abundance.clean_0.75 %>% as.data.frame() %>% as.matrix()
meta   <- Italy.orf.metadata.clean_0.75 %>% as.data.frame() %>% tibble::rownames_to_column("sample_id")

# Align samples
common <- intersect(colnames(counts), meta$sample_id)
counts <- counts[, common, drop = FALSE]
meta   <- meta  %>% filter(sample_id %in% common)


# Bray–Curtis on relative abundances
X        <- t(counts)  # samples x ORFs
row_sums <- rowSums(X)
X_rel    <- sweep(X, 1, pmax(row_sums, 1e-12), "/")
D_bray   <- vegdist(X_rel, method = "bray")

# Reorder metadata to match distance matrix
ord_ids <- rownames(as.matrix(D_bray))
meta    <- meta %>% slice(match(ord_ids, sample_id))

# Coerce factors (important)
meta <- meta %>%
  mutate(
    Dx.Status = forcats::fct_relevel(as.factor(Dx.Status), "CONTROL"),
    onset_timeline_combined = as.factor(onset_timeline_combined),
    patientID = as.factor(patientID),
    Sex = as.factor(Sex),
    HLA.Category = as.factor(HLA.Category),
    feeding_first_year = as.factor(feeding_first_year),
    Delivery.Mode = as.factor(Delivery.Mode),
    Age.at.Gluten.Introduction..months. = as.numeric(Age.at.Gluten.Introduction..months.)
  )

# ---- mixed MDMR: fixed effects + random intercept for patientID ----
fmla_mixed <- ~ Dx.Status * onset_timeline_combined + Sex + Age.at.Gluten.Introduction..months. +
               HLA.Category + feeding_first_year + Delivery.Mode + (1 | patientID)

# Tip for Bray (non-Euclidean): use.ssd ~ 0.99 can speed up
fit_mmdmr <- mixed.mdmr(
  fmla = fmla_mixed,
  data = meta,
  D    = D_bray,
  use.ssd = 0.99,   # set to 1.00 if you prefer full SSD (slower)
  ncores = 1        # >1 uses forking; keep 1 on Windows
)
```

# COMPOSITIONAL ANALYSIS
# Trajectory-based analysis focusing on temporal patterns and individual slopes

```{r compositional_analysis_setup}
library(vegan)
library(ggplot2)
library(cowplot)

# Calculate diversity metrics for total cohort
calculate_diversity_metrics <- function(abundance_matrix, metadata) {
  # Transpose so samples are rows
  abundance_t <- t(abundance_matrix)
  
  # Calculate various diversity metrics
  diversity_metrics <- data.frame(
    sample_id = rownames(abundance_t),
    shannon = diversity(abundance_t, index = "shannon"),
    simpson = diversity(abundance_t, index = "simpson"),
    richness = specnumber(abundance_t),
    evenness = diversity(abundance_t, index = "shannon") / log(specnumber(abundance_t))
  ) %>%
    left_join(metadata %>% rownames_to_column("sample_id"), by = "sample_id")
  
  return(diversity_metrics)
}

# Total cohort diversity
total_diversity <- calculate_diversity_metrics(total.orf.abundance.clean_0.75_0.03, total.orf.metadata.clean_0.75_0.03)
write.csv(total_diversity, "../Orf_orf_Phrog_compositional/orf_results/total_diversity_metrics.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

# Individual trajectory analysis
```{r individual_trajectories}
# Calculate individual slopes for abundance changes over time
calculate_individual_slopes <- function(abundance_matrix, metadata, min_timepoints = 3) {
  # Convert to long format
  abundance_long <- abundance_matrix %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    rownames_to_column("orf_id") %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = -orf_id, names_to = "sample_id", values_to = "abundance") %>%
    left_join(metadata %>% rownames_to_column("sample_id"), by = "sample_id") %>%
    filter(!is.na(onset_timeline_combined))
  
  # Convert timepoint to numeric (months before diagnosis)
  abundance_long$timepoint_numeric <- case_when(
    abundance_long$onset_timeline_combined == "t0" ~ 0,
    abundance_long$onset_timeline_combined == "t0-6" ~ -6,
    abundance_long$onset_timeline_combined == "t0-12" ~ -12,
    abundance_long$onset_timeline_combined == "t0-18" ~ -18,
    abundance_long$onset_timeline_combined == "t0-24" ~ -24,
    abundance_long$onset_timeline_combined == "t0-30" ~ -30,
    abundance_long$onset_timeline_combined == "t0-36" ~ -36,
    abundance_long$onset_timeline_combined == "t0-over42" ~ -45,
    TRUE ~ NA_real_
  )
  
  # Calculate slopes for each patient-gene combination
  slopes <- abundance_long %>%
    group_by(patientID, orf_id, Dx.Status) %>%
    filter(n() >= min_timepoints) %>%
    do({
      model <- lm(log1p(abundance) ~ timepoint_numeric, data = .)
      data.frame(
        slope = coef(model)[2],
        r_squared = summary(model)$r.squared,
        p_value = summary(model)$coefficients[2, 4]
      )
    }) %>%
    ungroup()
  
  return(slopes)
}

# Calculate slopes for total cohort
total_slopes <- calculate_individual_slopes(total.orf.abundance.clean_0.75_0.03, total.orf.metadata.clean_0.75_0.03)
write.csv(total_slopes, "../Orf_orf_Phrog_compositional/orf_results/total_individual_trajectories.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

# Stability analysis
```{r stability_analysis}
# Calculate coefficient of variation (CV) for each gene across timepoints
calculate_stability_metrics <- function(abundance_matrix, metadata) {
  # Long format
  abundance_long <- abundance_matrix %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    rownames_to_column("orf_id") %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = -orf_id, names_to = "sample_id", values_to = "abundance") %>%
    left_join(metadata %>% rownames_to_column("sample_id"), by = "sample_id")
  
  # Calculate stability metrics by patient and gene
  stability <- abundance_long %>%
    group_by(patientID, orf_id, Dx.Status) %>%
    filter(n() >= 3) %>%  # At least 3 timepoints
    summarise(
      mean_abundance = mean(abundance, na.rm = TRUE),
      cv = sd(abundance, na.rm = TRUE) / mean(abundance, na.rm = TRUE),
      stability_score = 1 / (1 + cv),  # Higher = more stable
      .groups = 'drop'
    )
  
  return(stability)
}

# Calculate stability for total cohort
total_stability <- calculate_stability_metrics(total.orf.abundance.clean_0.75_0.03, total.orf.metadata.clean_0.75_0.03)
write.csv(total_stability, "../Orf_orf_Phrog_compositional/orf_results/total_stability_metrics.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

# Clustering analysis based on temporal patterns
```{r clustering_analysis}
# Cluster patients based on temporal abundance patterns
cluster_temporal_patterns <- function(abundance_matrix, metadata, n_clusters = 4) {
  # Calculate patient-level temporal summaries
  abundance_long <- abundance_matrix %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    rownames_to_column("orf_id") %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = -orf_id, names_to = "sample_id", values_to = "abundance") %>%
    left_join(metadata %>% rownames_to_column("sample_id"), by = "sample_id")
  
  # Create patient-timepoint matrix
  patient_timepoint <- abundance_long %>%
    group_by(patientID, onset_timeline_combined, Dx.Status) %>%
    summarise(total_abundance = sum(abundance, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = 'drop') %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = onset_timeline_combined, values_from = total_abundance, values_fill = 0)
  
  # Perform clustering
  cluster_data <- patient_timepoint %>%
    select(-patientID, -Dx.Status) %>%
    as.matrix()
  
  # Handle missing values
  cluster_data[is.na(cluster_data)] <- 0
  
  # K-means clustering
  if(nrow(cluster_data) > n_clusters) {
    kmeans_result <- kmeans(cluster_data, centers = n_clusters, nstart = 25)
    
    # Add cluster assignments back
    patient_timepoint$cluster <- kmeans_result$cluster
    
    return(list(
      patient_clusters = patient_timepoint,
      cluster_centers = kmeans_result$centers,
      within_ss = kmeans_result$tot.withinss
    ))
  } else {
    return(NULL)
  }
}

# Perform clustering for total cohort
total_clusters <- cluster_temporal_patterns(total.orf.abundance.clean_0.75_0.03, total.orf.metadata.clean_0.75_0.03)
if(!is.null(total_clusters)) {
  write.csv(total_clusters$patient_clusters, "../Orf_orf_Phrog_compositional/orf_results/total_patient_clusters.csv", row.names = FALSE)
}
```

# CREATE ANALYSIS SUMMARY

```{r analysis_summary}
# Create summary of all model results
create_analysis_summary <- function() {
  model_files <- list.files("../Orf_orf_Phrog_compositional/orf_results/", pattern = "\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)
  
  summary_data <- data.frame()
  
  for(file in model_files) {
    if(grepl("timepoint_specific", file)) next  # Skip timepoint files for main summary
    
    tryCatch({
      data <- read.csv(file)
      
      if(nrow(data) > 0 && "p.value" %in% colnames(data)) {
        file_summary <- data.frame(
          file = basename(file),
          cohort = gsub("_.*", "", basename(file)),
          model_type = ifelse(grepl("PA", basename(file)), "PA", "Abundance"),
          total_results = nrow(data),
          significant_results = sum(data$p.value < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
          valid_pvalues = sum(!is.na(data$p.value)),
          convergence_rate = round(sum(!is.na(data$p.value)) / nrow(data) * 100, 1)
        )
        
        summary_data <- rbind(summary_data, file_summary)
      }
    }, error = function(e) {
      cat("Error processing file:", file, "\n")
    })
  }
  
  return(summary_data)
}

# Generate analysis summary
```

```{r basic_visualizations}
library(ggplot2)
library(cowplot)
library(viridis)

# Function to create effect size plots for all models
create_effect_size_plots <- function(timepoint_file, output_name, title_prefix) {
  if(!file.exists(timepoint_file)) {
    cat("File not found:", timepoint_file, "\n")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  # Load timepoint results
  data <- read.csv(timepoint_file)
  
  if(nrow(data) == 0) {
    cat("No data in file:", timepoint_file, "\n")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  cat("Creating effect size plot for", nrow(data), "results from", basename(timepoint_file), "\n")
  
  # Prepare data for plotting
  data$has_pvalue <- !is.na(data$p.value)
  data$neg_log10_p <- ifelse(data$has_pvalue, -log10(data$p.value), NA)
  data$is_significant <- data$has_pvalue & data$p.value < 0.05
  
  # Traditional volcano plot (only valid p-values)
  data_valid <- data[data$has_pvalue, ]
  
  if(nrow(data_valid) > 0) {
    p1 <- ggplot(data_valid, aes(x = estimate, y = neg_log10_p)) +
      geom_point(aes(color = is_significant, shape = timepoint), 
                 alpha = 0.7, size = 2) +
      scale_color_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "#E74C3C", "FALSE" = "#95A5A6"),
                         labels = c("TRUE" = "Significant (p<0.05)", "FALSE" = "Not significant"),
                         name = "Significance") +
      labs(title = paste(title_prefix, "- Effect Sizes"),
           subtitle = paste0("Showing ", nrow(data_valid), " out of ", nrow(data), " results with valid p-values"),
           x = "Effect Size (Log Odds/Fold Change)",
           y = "-log10(p-value)") +
      theme_minimal() +
      theme(legend.position = "bottom",
            plot.title = element_text(size = 11),
            plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 9, color = "gray60"))
  } else {
    # Create empty plot if no valid p-values
    p1 <- ggplot() + 
      annotate("text", x = 0, y = 0, 
               label = "No valid p-values found\n(All models failed to converge)", 
               size = 5, color = "red") +
      labs(title = paste(title_prefix, "- Effect Sizes"),
           subtitle = "No convergent models found",
           x = "Effect Size", y = "-log10(p-value)") +
      theme_void()
  }
  
  # Save effect size plot
  output_file <- paste0("../Orf_orf_Phrog_compositional/orf_figures/", output_name, "_effect_sizes.pdf")
  ggsave(output_file, p1, width = 10, height = 8, device = "pdf")
  
  cat("Effect size plot saved:", basename(output_file), "\n")
  
  return(p1)
}
```

```{r heatmap_visualizations}
library(pheatmap)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(reshape2)

# Define correct timepoint order
timepoint_order <- c("t0", "t0-6", "t0-12", "t0-18", "t0-24", "t0-30", "t0-36", "t0-over42")

# Function to create heatmap
create_heatmap <- function(timepoint_file, output_name, title_prefix) {
  if(!file.exists(timepoint_file)) {
    cat("File not found:", timepoint_file, "\n")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  # Load timepoint results
  data <- read.csv(timepoint_file)
  
  if(nrow(data) == 0) {
    cat("No data in file:", timepoint_file, "\n")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  cat("Processing", nrow(data), "results from", basename(timepoint_file), "\n")
  
  # Filter for significant results (p < 0.05) and create matrix
  sig_data <- data %>%
    filter(p.value < 0.05) %>%
    select(gene, timepoint, estimate, p.value)
  
  if(nrow(sig_data) == 0) {
    cat("No significant results found for", output_name, "\n")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  # Create matrix for heatmap (genes x timepoints)
  estimate_matrix <- sig_data %>%
    select(gene, timepoint, estimate) %>%
    dcast(gene ~ timepoint, value.var = "estimate", fill = 0)
  
  # Convert to matrix
  rownames(estimate_matrix) <- estimate_matrix$gene
  estimate_matrix <- estimate_matrix[, -1, drop = FALSE]
  estimate_matrix <- as.matrix(estimate_matrix)
  
  # Remove genes with all zeros
  estimate_matrix <- estimate_matrix[rowSums(abs(estimate_matrix)) > 0, , drop = FALSE]
  
  if(nrow(estimate_matrix) == 0) {
    cat("No genes with non-zero estimates for", output_name, "\n")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  # Reorder columns to match timepoint order
  available_timepoints <- intersect(timepoint_order, colnames(estimate_matrix))
  if(length(available_timepoints) > 0) {
    estimate_matrix <- estimate_matrix[, available_timepoints, drop = FALSE]
  }
  
  cat("Creating heatmap with", nrow(estimate_matrix), "genes and", ncol(estimate_matrix), "timepoints\n")
  
  # Calculate dimensions
  n_genes <- nrow(estimate_matrix)
  n_timepoints <- ncol(estimate_matrix)
  
  cell_height <- 0.3
  cell_width <- 0.8
  
  fig_height <- max(4, min(12, n_genes * cell_height + 2))
  fig_width <- max(6, n_timepoints * cell_width + 3)
  
  # Create heatmap
  pdf(paste0("../Orf_orf_Phrog_compositional/orf_figures/", output_name, "_heatmap.pdf"), 
      width = fig_width, height = fig_height)
  
  pheatmap(estimate_matrix,
           cluster_rows = TRUE,
           cluster_cols = FALSE,
           scale = "none",
           color = colorRampPalette(rev(brewer.pal(11, "RdBu")))(100),
           breaks = seq(-max(abs(estimate_matrix)), max(abs(estimate_matrix)), length.out = 101),
           main = paste(title_prefix, "- Log Odds/Fold Change (CELIAC vs CONTROL)"),
           fontsize = 10,
           fontsize_row = 8,
           fontsize_col = 10,
           show_rownames = TRUE,
           border_color = "white",
           cellwidth = 25,
           cellheight = 12,
           treeheight_row = 30,
           treeheight_col = 0,
           angle_col = 45)
  
  dev.off()
  
  return(estimate_matrix)
}
```

```{r improved_effect_plots}
# Create improved effect size visualizations that show the full picture
create_improved_effect_plots <- function(timepoint_file, output_name, title_prefix) {
  if(!file.exists(timepoint_file)) {
    cat("File not found:", timepoint_file, "\n")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  # Load timepoint results
  data <- read.csv(timepoint_file)
  
  if(nrow(data) == 0) {
    cat("No data in file:", timepoint_file, "\n")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  cat("Processing", nrow(data), "results from", basename(timepoint_file), "\n")
  
  # Prepare data for plotting
  data$has_pvalue <- !is.na(data$p.value)
  data$neg_log10_p <- ifelse(data$has_pvalue, -log10(data$p.value), NA)
  data$is_significant <- data$has_pvalue & data$p.value < 0.05
  
  # Summary statistics
  n_total <- nrow(data)
  n_with_pvalue <- sum(data$has_pvalue)
  n_significant <- sum(data$is_significant, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  cat("Data summary for", output_name, ":\n")
  cat("  Total results:", n_total, "\n")
  cat("  With valid p-values:", n_with_pvalue, "(", round(100*n_with_pvalue/n_total, 1), "%)\n")
  cat("  Significant (p<0.05):", n_significant, "\n")
  cat("  Effect size range:", round(min(data$estimate, na.rm=TRUE), 2), "to", round(max(data$estimate, na.rm=TRUE), 2), "\n")
  
  # Create multiple plots to show the full picture
  
  # Plot 1: All effect sizes (including NAs)
  p1 <- ggplot(data, aes(x = estimate, y = timepoint)) +
    geom_point(aes(color = has_pvalue, shape = is_significant), 
               alpha = 0.7, size = 2) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "#2E86AB", "FALSE" = "#F24236"),
                       labels = c("TRUE" = "Valid p-value", "FALSE" = "No p-value (NA)"),
                       name = "Statistical Status") +
    scale_shape_manual(values = c("TRUE" = 16, "FALSE" = 1),
                       labels = c("TRUE" = "Significant", "FALSE" = "Not significant"),
                       name = "Significance",
                       na.value = 4) +
    labs(title = paste(title_prefix, "- All Effect Sizes"),
         subtitle = paste0("Total: ", n_total, " | Valid p-values: ", n_with_pvalue, 
                          " (", round(100*n_with_pvalue/n_total, 1), "%)"),
         x = "Effect Size (Log Odds/Fold Change)",
         y = "Timepoint") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom",
          plot.title = element_text(size = 11),
          plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 9, color = "gray60")) +
    guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 3)),
           shape = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 3)))
  
  # Plot 2: Distribution of effect sizes
  p2 <- ggplot(data, aes(x = estimate)) +
    geom_histogram(aes(fill = has_pvalue), bins = 30, alpha = 0.7, position = "stack") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "#2E86AB", "FALSE" = "#F24236"),
                      labels = c("TRUE" = "Valid p-value", "FALSE" = "No p-value (NA)"),
                      name = "Statistical Status") +
    labs(title = "Distribution of Effect Sizes",
         subtitle = "Red bars show large effects with no p-values (model convergence issues)",
         x = "Effect Size (Log Odds/Fold Change)",
         y = "Count") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom",
          plot.title = element_text(size = 11),
          plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 9, color = "gray60"))
  
  # Plot 3: Traditional volcano plot (only valid p-values)
  data_valid <- data[data$has_pvalue, ]
  
  if(nrow(data_valid) > 0) {
    p3 <- ggplot(data_valid, aes(x = estimate, y = neg_log10_p)) +
      geom_point(aes(color = is_significant, shape = timepoint), 
                 alpha = 0.7, size = 2) +
      scale_color_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "#E74C3C", "FALSE" = "#95A5A6"),
                         labels = c("TRUE" = "Significant (p<0.05)", "FALSE" = "Not significant"),
                         name = "Significance") +
      labs(title = "Traditional Volcano Plot (Valid P-values Only)",
           subtitle = paste0("Showing ", nrow(data_valid), " out of ", n_total, " results"),
           x = "Effect Size (Log Odds/Fold Change)",
           y = "-log10(p-value)") +
      theme_minimal() +
      theme(legend.position = "bottom",
            plot.title = element_text(size = 11),
            plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 9, color = "gray60"))
  } else {
    # Create empty plot if no valid p-values
    p3 <- ggplot() + 
      annotate("text", x = 0, y = 0, 
               label = "No valid p-values found\n(All models failed to converge)", 
               size = 5, color = "red") +
      labs(title = "Traditional Volcano Plot (Valid P-values Only)",
           subtitle = "No convergent models found",
           x = "Effect Size", y = "-log10(p-value)") +
      theme_void()
  }
  
  # Combine plots
  combined_plot <- plot_grid(p1, p2, p3, 
                            ncol = 1, 
                            rel_heights = c(1, 0.8, 1),
                            align = "v")
  
  # Save improved effect size plot
  output_file <- paste0("../Orf_orf_Phrog_compositional/orf_figures/", output_name, "_improved_effects.pdf")
  ggsave(output_file, combined_plot, width = 10, height = 12, device = "pdf")
  
  cat("Improved effect size plot saved:", basename(output_file), "\n")
  
  return(list(
    total_results = n_total,
    valid_pvalues = n_with_pvalue,
    significant = n_significant,
    effect_range = c(min(data$estimate, na.rm=TRUE), max(data$estimate, na.rm=TRUE))
  ))
}

# Create improved effect plots for main models (to be run after timepoint extraction)
cat("Improved effect size visualization functions loaded\n")
```
